Ability.description: The six ability scores, used as skill keys and save keys.
Ability.title: Ability

AbilityBlock.description: One row of the ability table: the score actually in effect and its modifier.
AbilityBlock.title: AbilityBlock

ArmorSlot.title: ArmorSlot

AttackRow.description: One ATTACK block. ``attack_bonus`` and ``damage`` are typed by the user in phase 1.
AttackRow.title: AttackRow

CharacterBody.description:
Every field on both pages of the paper sheet, including those not yet computed.

Every field has a default, so ``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`` gives true partial-update
semantics on ``PATCH`` without a parallel all-optional model.
CharacterBody.title: CharacterBody

CharacterCreate.description: Creating a character asks for a name and nothing else; everything else has a default.
CharacterCreate.title: CharacterCreate

CharacterPatch.description: A partial update. ``version`` is the value the client last read; a stale one is a 409.
CharacterPatch.title: CharacterPatch

CharacterSummary.description: A row of the character list. Deliberately narrow — the list does not derive anything.
CharacterSummary.title: CharacterSummary

CharacterWithDerived.description: What ``GET`` and ``PATCH`` of a single character return.
CharacterWithDerived.title: CharacterWithDerived

DerivedAbilities.description:
The six ability rows.

Named fields rather than a dictionary keyed by ``Ability``: a mapping schema generates a
TypeScript index signature, and the frontend would lose the guarantee that every ability is
present. Indexing by ``Ability`` still works for the engine's own use.
DerivedAbilities.title: DerivedAbilities

DerivedSaves.description: The three saving-throw rows, named for the same reason the abilities are.
DerivedSaves.title: DerivedSaves

DerivedSheet.description: Every number the paper sheet asks you to work out by hand.
DerivedSheet.title: DerivedSheet

NamedReference.description: A feat or special ability, with the **PG.** column the paper sheet prints beside it.
NamedReference.title: NamedReference

PossessionRow-Input.description: An OTHER POSSESSIONS row. Stored in JSONB because it is only ever summed.
PossessionRow-Input.title: PossessionRow

PossessionRow-Output.description: An OTHER POSSESSIONS row. Stored in JSONB because it is only ever summed.
PossessionRow-Output.title: PossessionRow

RuleWarning.description:
A rules violation that the application reports rather than refuses.

House rules and homebrew are normal play, so nothing here is an error. Named ``RuleWarning``
rather than ``Warning`` so it does not shadow the builtin.
RuleWarning.title: RuleWarning

SkillRow-Input.description: One SKILLS row as stored. Exactly one of ``skill_id`` and ``custom_name`` is set.
SkillRow-Input.title: SkillRow

SkillRow-Output.description: One SKILLS row as stored. Exactly one of ``skill_id`` and ``custom_name`` is set.
SkillRow-Output.title: SkillRow
